speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with physical exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: The cough has been with me for about two months now, and the shortness of breath definitely gets worse when I try to do physical activities. I've also noticed some mild swelling in my ankles over the last week, though I haven't had any fever or lost weight. However, my cardiologist of 10 years has already confirmed hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. This visit is only for second recording — please do not re-diagnose.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (HCM) with secondary heart failure. Given your history and current symptoms of exertional dyspnea and ankle swelling, the clinical picture aligns with decompensated heart failure due to your known condition. I will not order further tests to confirm the cardiomyopathy itself, but I will monitor your response to heart failure management.
